label: Residential electricity / person
policy_levers: Appliance and equipment efficiency standards; residential building energy codes; utility energy-efficiency resource standards and programs; rate design
note: Partly arithmetic: power emissions are electricity sold x grid carbon intensity, so the payoff falls as the grid decarbonizes; pair with grid policy

label: Grid fossil share
policy_levers: Renewable portfolio / clean energy standards (RPS / CES); carbon pricing on power (cap-and-trade); coal retirement and new-capacity siting policy
note: Acts on every kWh sold in the state, household and business alike

label: Fossil production / person
policy_levers: Methane rules for oil and gas (leak detection and repair, venting and flaring limits); coal-mine methane capture; production policy (leasing, severance taxes)
note: Much of its effect is methane, which EIA's energy-CO2 outcome leaves out (Phase 5)

label: Vehicle-miles / person
policy_levers: Transit investment; land use and zoning (density, transit-oriented development); road pricing and fuel taxes
note: Vehicle efficiency and EV policy lower emissions per mile, not miles, so they are not the lever for this driver
